name: api
description: Turborepo wrapper around the uv-managed FastAPI project. Python deps live in pyproject.toml.

scripts.worker: uv run celery -A app.worker worker -l info
scripts.lint: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.format: uv run ruff check --fix . && uv run ruff format .
scripts.format:check: uv run ruff format --check . && uv run ruff check --select I .
